method.nodes: Board return names are CONDITIONAL lumped comparators, never native connected components. All source networks remain unimplemented/unqualified.
method.injection_class: Balanced signed injections, sum positive = sum negative magnitudes <=4.6 A; no equal sharing or rail cancellation. Whole-domain class deliberately conservative for EL/O boards.
method.current_formula: I_bound = 4.6 * R_alt / (R_min + R_alt); remove candidate, all other wire/contact paths at maxima; candidate cold cable resistance minimum, candidate contact/access minimum zero.
method.proof: Reciprocity plus passive maximum principle bounds transfer voltage by effective resistance times total injection. Rayleigh monotonicity bounds alternative resistance. Open alternate path gives 4.6 A, never zero.
method.access_model: Add ONE 0.5 mOhm total omitted copper/access inventory bound to wire-only R_alt. Sufficient but stronger than original path requirement: sum of every distinct unmodeled neck/access resistor upper bound in expanded graph <=0.5mOhm. This additionally requires complete connected access subgraphs joining ALL collapsed terminals so every ideal unit flow can be lifted. Disconnected copper cannot qualify at any resistance. Unit-flow energy gives R_alt <= R_wire + sum(R_access). No per-board allowance, zero-access claim, shared-neck omission or parallel-layer credit. Extraction/equivalence NOT RUN; actual feasible allocation unknown.
method.uncertainty: Wire hot/cold and contact limits are assembled acceptance requirements, not measurements or manufacturer guarantees. .1 ohm GH alternative allowance is retained two-end contact/crimp requirement. Continuous/cut lengths from mechanical proposals only.
method.excluded: Stored capacitor energy, arbitrary external patch injection, missing/late rails, unbounded fault currents and protection dynamics. No patch-sleeve edge is credited.
method.bound_failure: A bound above0.5 A blocks this conservative certificate, not proof of actual overload; refined source-supported injections/access graph may tighten it without relaxing limits.
